chapterAssessments.assessment: The long practical debate retains movement because Tan-chun pushes concrete inefficiencies, Bao-chai elevates and teases, Patience answers diplomatically and Li Wan interrupts their scholarship. Tan-chun's tears briefly change the register without sentimentalising her management. The formal Zhen visit then opens into repetitive, disorienting dream dialogue. The mirrored maids' rejection and the abrupt master summons give the final movement its own rhythm. No global shortening is warranted.

The ordinary cough inquiry turns into an uncontrolled crisis through a credible escalation of hearsay. Nurse Li's lament, Aroma's furious sarcasm and the doctor's missed joke are audible as different voices. The private Nightingale conversation is less public and more practical than Bao-yu's ash-and-smoke extremity. Marriage negotiations and the pawn-ticket sequence counterbalance romantic feeling with money and dependence. The backward reference at b29 needs the bounded chronology correction R01; the rest of the chapter needs no general rewrite.

The funeral administration is deliberately dense but readable, then releases into the garden's image-rich sequence. 'Golden threads', 'rosy clouds' and the repeated fruit line connect Bao-yu's overreading of seasonal change with Ou-guan's actual grief. The hair-washing and soup episodes delay disclosure without losing its thread. The private love account is neither euphemised into friendship nor given modern labels. A full stage-role note would repeat what the prose already explains.

The initial logistical catalogue makes the power vacuum concrete, followed by the more relaxed willow-basket scene. Swallow's long family explanation remains conversational and needed for three-woman distinction. Joking turns into actual violence without confusing who strikes whom. Oriole's retaliation prevents a simplistic victim/hero split. The mock rebellion language and relayed order turn the title's military register into household comedy, while the widow's plea keeps material stakes visible.

The apology gives a short reset before the powder gift changes hands and becomes an insult. The quarrel has clear physical staging and differentiates Aroma's real intervention from Skybright's feigned one. Kitchen favouritism, Parfumée's arrogance and Wu-er's urgency are allowed to coexist with previous sympathy. Past perfect in b34 correctly handles the source's backward glance. Rose essence and fuling travel along independent, intelligible chains, and the final gate challenge preserves suspense without later plot imports.
